subject: [PATCH nfs-utils 4/4] nfsd-iomode-advisor: recommend riomode= and wiomode= for an export

2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch adds a tool called nfsd-iomode-advisor that recommends the optimal NFSD IO mode (buffered, dontcache, or direct) for an export based on various metrics and thresholds. The tool samples performance metrics while clients use the export and provides recommendations with reasons. It considers factors such as miss ratio, reclaim vs storage traffic, CPU time of kswapd/kcompactd threads, dirty/writeback ratios, free memory vs zone high watermarks, and average READ/WRITE sizes. The tool also probes for mode limits and caveats, ensuring that the recommended mode is suitable for the export's characteristics and does not silently fall back to a different mode.
